ink_host/ — the logger host pkg: a pure
declaration surface. The embedding Rust binds the bodies
(`logger::pkg` → `ink_host::create_logger` /
`ink_host::logger_log`); `ink` wraps them in the `Logger` class.

The registration scope IS the package name; the use path spells it
too (`use ink_host::{create_logger}`).
